description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'VoiceWakeOverlayView' that provides an overlay UI component for voice wake interactions, including text editing, send button, and close button functionalities.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View responsible for rendering the overlay UI for voice wake interactions, including editing state and send/cancel controls.

classes.description: A private SwiftUI View providing a visual effect background with border stroke for the overlay.

classes.description: A SwiftUI View that conditionally displays a close button overlay with hover effects.
